name: intent-agentic-payment-router
description: Intent-Based Agentic Payment Router Hackathon MVP Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:shared" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix contracts run compile
scripts.test: npm --prefix shared run test && npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix contracts run test
